snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.5 - Birthday Bonanza!
snippet.description:
Chris's Classroom V1.5 update is out now, and the Birthday Bonanza mode has been completed!

↓↓↓ Update V1.5 Log ↓↓↓

- Finished Birthday Bonanza mode! Collect presents and smash cakes to escape the college!
- Updated most UI elements to avoid overlapping
- Added channel name to title screen

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in game are created by me!
